arguments.where_clause: card_id IN (SELECT id FROM cards WHERE card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)')
arguments.explanation: Flags every transaction made on a prepaid debit card. It does not flag ordinary debit or credit cards.
assumptions: 'Prepaid debit card' is taken to mean card_type = 'Debit (Prepaid)'. Plain 'Debit' cards and Credit cards are not flagged.
No amount, date, channel or error condition is added, so the rule flags all prepaid debit transactions regardless of size.
